text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"“The information from the sensors can cause the car to apply brakes…” and “could prevent many crashes”","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It supports its position with a direct article detail and explains how that detail helps its argument."},{"evidence":"“help to add knowledge and protection… prevent humans from getting into crashes”","quality":"development of claims","description":"It expands each point with more explanation instead of just restating a simple opinion."},{"evidence":"“Currently… They are good, because… These cars are bad, because…”","quality":"argumentative balance","description":"It acknowledges both benefits and drawbacks before defending a conclusion, which makes the stance feel more considered."},{"evidence":"three full paragraphs with an introduction, body, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It has a clearer essay structure with distinct sections that make the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“The world needs a change and the economy needs a crutch to lie on.”","quality":"rhetorical force","description":"It uses more emphatic and varied language to make the conclusion sound more persuasive."}]}
